subject: Re: Generative trees — kickoff
body:
Hi Anders,

Staffing: Jorge 60% (implementation and CI), Katya 50% (fidelity evals), Yusuf 30% (privacy analysis with Kofi's team).

Compute: refreshingly boring — Java Wrapper training runs on standard CPU hosts; no accelerator ask this quarter.

The data plan is the critical path: the two internal tables need to be in Corpus before the v2 migration freeze on 2026-06-26, so ingestion must complete by Jun 19 — same date as our internal-tables milestone, not a coincidence, I aligned them. Katya owns the ingestion tickets.

Also starting the privacy review now given the 2-3 week SLA; synthetic-data products always get extra scrutiny from Kofi.

Bruno
